### 2026-10-18 – I ended up scrapping my earlier broken CAD attempt and deleted everything to start fresh from scratch. I created the initial 30 mm thick base (Extrude 1), which was honestly way too chunky, but it gav

**5h**

I ended up scrapping my earlier broken CAD attempt and deleted everything to start fresh from scratch. I created the initial 30 mm thick base (Extrude 1), which was honestly way too chunky, but it gave me a starting block to work with.

![Screenshot 128](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/gSMICPeKfFIX4r61sX8jLHHguUkM0Btr/fe5562fa30d9157c0f72ca19cbce5173e12cc27707bf3ebcca97f17c4a5acb5f.png)

Looking at it from the Front plane with Sketch 10 open. On the right side of the 30 mm base, I extruded 3 steps (Extrude 6) and put a solid cylinder next to it. Up top, I added Plane 1 and swept an angled hollow tube (Sweep 1) across the corner as a gravity drop. Over on the left, I made  a floating test platform with a spiral coil underneath it to test how a lift or spiral drop might work.

![Screenshot 138](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/gSMICPeKfFIX4r61sX8jLHHguUkM0Btr/4d55f23682a5c670142d2621cae7f56dafd7a49e34908c92e167371d4a2055da.png)

Switched over to isometric view. I modeled the marble itself using Sketch 8 and Revolve 1. It is an 8 mm sphere colored orange so I could check scale against the track features. Right now the orange ball is sitting on the top ledge of that left platform. On the main base you can see the 3 stairs, the cylinder, and the diagonal tube cutting across.

![Screenshot 160](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/gSMICPeKfFIX4r61sX8jLHHguUkM0Btr/4edbd1c06eb1b518d5428cfd3cf2d95689799f527466dbf78e643f59fb1aad53.png)

Opened the appearances panel on the right and color-coded every part so I could tell them apart instead of staring at a blob of default grey. Part 1 is the light blue base, Part 3 is the dark blue spiral coil under the side block, Part 6 is the orange marble, and the rest are shades of grey and blue. Viewing from the left side shows how everything was still floating in separate pieces, and I created a Part Studio 2 tab to mess around with other shapes.

![Screenshot 176](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/gSMICPeKfFIX4r61sX8jLHHguUkM0Btr/057c9bf95cf73b96c055a5b7217949677e4b347250772e58089e35c36b6df2a0.png)

![Screenshot 198](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/gSMICPeKfFIX4r61sX8jLHHguUkM0Btr/ecfa65392efaead2259af462c299629ed70b0cb25059b9cdb6089a1113d2f02e.png)
In the back-left corner, I sketched and extruded 7 vertical support pillars (Sketch 12 and Extrude 9) to hold up the upper track sections later on. I also added vertical boundary walls (Extrude 8 and Extrude 10) along the rear and left side to keep the track layout contained.
![Screenshot 237](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/gSMICPeKfFIX4r61sX8jLHHguUkM0Btr/e9621c9c388fce9bf7b715b9e54e5387cc42788b0a04a16a1279597dc87a05a6.png)

![Screenshot 256](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/gSMICPeKfFIX4r61sX8jLHHguUkM0Btr/8f4129d5065eee13b7de4ad408fd4eb14a4b27a3d686c70d36be9d2182389d44.png)
The setup has the 7 support pillars in the corner, the Avengers Tower, and the rear wall span. The diagonal tube on the right is still hanging in mid-air floating over the gap right now .
